review.why: Every warning line and the list of regions read as at 06:25; only the hour labels of the page's time axis moved on ('06 12 18 00 ...' became '12 18 00 ...') as the day advanced.

ignored: IPMA's pages print the time of the visit (for example '03h24m UTC:') and the warnings timeline prints the hour labels of its time axis, which move on through the day: both are ignored when judging whether the page changed.
